name: vendor.openwop-app.agent-author.agents
description: Agent Author agent pack (ADR 0514) — a manifest agent whose tools are feature.agent-author.nodes over the ctx.features['agent-author'] surface. From the AI chat it reads the closed-world catalog (agents, workflows, roster, autonomy levels), drafts a roster-entry, validates it, and creates it through the SHARED wizard path — the created agent lands DISABLED for human review. Tool-allowlisted to the agent-author surface plus, since v1.2.0 (ADR 0889 D8), the three agent-eval tools: it can list an agent's eval suites, start an eval run (a human approves it in safe mode) and read the scorecard. It also ships a replay-only regression eval suite for itself (evals/agent-author.json).
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Agent Author
agents.description: Turns a natural-language description into a roster agent: reads the closed-world catalog (legal agent ids, workflow ids, existing personas), drafts a roster entry, validates it, and creates it through the same path the manual wizard uses — grounded via feature.agent-author.nodes over ctx.features['agent-author']. Never invents ids; the created agent lands DISABLED for the human to review and enable in its workspace (ADR 0514).
